text:
maya: Hey team — Customer ACME reports streaming dashboard showing negative tokens/sec and blank TTFT rows for several streams since ~09:12 UTC. Ticket #INC-4982.

carlos_oncall: Copy — can you paste a repro and any console logs?

maya: Repro steps from the customer: 1) Start streaming session via /v1/streams with streaming=true, model=redwood-13b, 2) send a 3–5 token prompt every 2s for ~3 minutes, 3) check Console > Streaming metrics > Tokens/sec. They see: some sessions show -1200 tokens/sec, others empty. Attached screenshot shows missing bars and negative point.

maya: Quick logs from their agent (redacted):
```
[2026-03-15T09:11:54Z] session_id=abc123 total_tokens=45 interval_ms=5000 tokens_in_interval=-6
[2026-03-15T09:11:59Z] metrics_emitter: send {session:abc123, tokens: -6, window_ms: 5000}
```

jenn_eng-runtime: That negative tokens value screams of a counter reset / delta calc bug in the emitter or aggregator. Two quick hypotheses: 1) client-side token counter wrapped/overflowed, 2) aggregation job subtracting counters across windows without monotonic enforcement.

rachel_analytics: We ingest metrics from the metrics-ingest topic into ClickHouse via the streaming-agg pipeline. I just checked consumer lag — no huge lag now, but there was a bump at 09:10 UTC on partition 4. Possible out-of-order events.

metrics-bot: alert: streaming-agg.pipeline.error_rate spike at 09:09:56 UTC (5xx from aggregator service)

maya: Customer also says when they disable their local batching (send each token immediately) metrics look normal. So likely related to how we compute deltas when emitter batches multiple tokens into one message.

jenn_eng-runtime: Can you provide the exact emitter payloads (JSON) they sent? Need to confirm fields: cumulative_total vs interval_count. If they send cumulative_total that decreases on reconnect we get negative deltas.

maya: Sent the payload example (redacted):
```
{"session":"abc123","cumulative_tokens":45,"interval_ms":5000}
{"session":"abc123","cumulative_tokens":39,"interval_ms":5000}
```

jenn_eng-runtime: Bingo — cumulative decreased from 45 to 39 (client restarted/reset counter). Aggregator is doing current.cumulative - previous.cumulative and didn't enforce >=0. I'll raise a fix to clamp negative deltas to 0 and add monotonicity checks.

rachel_analytics: Short-term: I can PATCH the dashboard query to use GREATEST(0, tokens_delta) to avoid negative plots, and hide rows with null TTFT. But that masks root cause; please keep eng-runtime looped in for fix.

terry_sre: Also check timestamps/timezones. If the emitter uses local time and we compute windows by message timestamp, out-of-order with small clocks skews can produce negative intervals/tokens/sec. Any clock skew evidence?

jenn_eng-runtime: Good call. I'll check server-side ingestion: verify we use kafka offset order and server-received timestamps to compute deltas. If client timestamps were used we should switch to server time as canonical.

emily_product: For customer comms: propose immediate mitigation in Console: 1) hide negative values and show "N/A" tooltip explaining "metrics temporarily unavailable", 2) add note to support KB explaining emitter best practices (send monotonic cumulative counters or per-interval counts).

maya: Customer updated: switching to per-interval counts fixed the visible dashboard within 30s. They're happy for now but want a root cause timeline and permanent fix.

jenn_eng-runtime: Action items I will own: - check aggregator delta logic and add clamp + unit tests (ETA 4h) - ensure server-received timestamp is used for windowing (ETA 2h) - add ingestion alert for negative-delta rate (ETA 6h).

rachel_analytics: My actions: - change dashboard query to GREATEST(0, tokens_delta) as hotfix (done) - add dashboard annotation for 09:10 incident - open follow-up to verify historical data integrity.

maya: I'll reply to customer with mitigation steps and ETA for engineering fix.

carlos_oncall: Thanks — mark this as P2 and tag oncall rotation. If anyone needs runbook help ping me. :thumbsup:

jenn_eng-runtime: Starting work now. If folks see any other customers with negative TTFT/empty tokens/sec please append to this thread.

maya: Closing the loop here once fixes land. Thanks everyone.
